name: v1.19.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Added

Add a context menu to execute actions on selected work items by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/401

### Minor Changes

* Bump aiohttp from 3.14.3 to 3.14.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/388
* Bump gitpython from 3.1.62 to 3.2.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/389
* Bump virtualenv from 21.14.5 to 21.14.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/390
* Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/394
* Bump virtualenv from 21.14.9 to 21.14.13 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/395
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/391
* Bump filelock from 3.29.0 to 4.2.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/392
* Bump msgpack from 1.2.1 to 1.2.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/393
* Bump setuptools from 83.0.0 to 84.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/396
* Remove unused urllib3 dependency by @booxter in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/402

### Bug Fixes

* fix Jira DC assignee search ignores search term (#397) by @davidferlay in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/398
* Fix crash when viewing work items with textarea custom fields on Jira  Data Center by @pelidan in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/399

## New Contributors
* @davidferlay made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/398
* @booxter made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/402
* @pelidan made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/399

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0
